name: Joan Walton
abstract_title: Re-imagining Education for an Evolution of Consciousness
abstract: If humanity is to realise a socially transformative shift in understanding consciousness—not merely as a by-product of the brain but as a fundamental aspect of reality—education must be re-imagined. The dominant materialist worldview, rooted in Newtonian science, has shaped educational systems that privilege objectivity, measurement, and external observation while marginalising the inner, subjective, and spiritual dimensions of experience.
